query: SELECT uses_knowledge_graph, evaluation_metric, retrieval_method FROM cspaper WHERE uses_knowledge_graph != 'Yes' OR retrieval_method = 'Sparse Retrieval; Dense Retrieval' OR evaluation_metric != 'top-1 accuracy; top-3 accuracy;Accuracy' OR performance_on_NQ = 'Ideal Setting (4√+1x): Qwen1.5-7B (EM: 29.10, F1 score: 41.02); Llama2-13B (EM: 33.60, F1 score: 44.62); Llama3-8B (EM: 36.90, F1 score: 48.45). GPT Setting (4√+1x): Qwen1.5-7B (EM: 23.10, F1 score: 34.84); Llama2-13B (EM: 25.10, F1 score: 35.56); Llama3-8B (EM: 30.70, F1 score: 41.71).';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
